n: UNLV Arduino line follower lesson plan
t: A six-part plan for building an Arduino robot that follows a black line.
steps: Find the Team 5 Line Follower lesson plan PDF.
Get a Wrebotics car kit for each team.
Gather an Arduino with a motor shield, sensors, and a laptop for each team.
Ask IT to install the Arduino software.
Have teams write pseudocode before coding.
Test line following and then add the ultrasonic sensor.
Hold a team presentation with a video demo.
